name: White
description: pure, bright white with no yellow tint

name: Cream
description: warm off-white with a soft yellow or beige tint - ivory, ecru, natural linen, beige, oatmeal, stone

name: Silver
description: metallic silver only - a shiny material, never hardware like buckles

name: Grey
description: any grey from light to charcoal, with no warm tint

name: Black
description: reads as black even in good light. A very dark navy, brown or burgundy that's clearly tinted is not black

name: Tan
description: light, warm sandy brown - sand, light caramel, light suede

name: Camel
description: golden mid-brown, like a classic camel coat

name: Gold
description: metallic gold only - a shiny material, never hardware like buckles

name: Copper
description: reddish-orange brown - rust, terracotta, burnt orange - and metallic copper

name: Brown
description: mid to dark brown - chocolate, coffee, espresso

name: Peach
description: soft pale orange-pink - apricot, peach

name: Orange
description: clear, bright orange

name: Butter Yellow
description: pale, soft yellow - butter, lemon sorbet

name: Bright Yellow
description: vivid, saturated yellow

name: Lime Green
description: light or bright yellow-green - lime, apple, pistachio

name: Green
description: true mid green - grass, kelly, emerald

name: Olive Green
description: muted brownish or greyish green - olive, khaki green, sage

name: Forest Green
description: deep, dark green - bottle, hunter, pine

name: Turquoise
description: bright light blue-green - aqua, turquoise

name: Teal
description: deep blue-green - teal, petrol

name: Light Blue
description: pale or sky blue - powder blue, light-wash denim

name: Bright Blue
description: vivid, saturated blue - cobalt, electric, royal blue

name: Dark Blue
description: deep blue that is still clearly blue - indigo, mid and dark-wash denim

name: Navy
description: very dark blue, almost black

name: Lilac
description: pale purple - lavender, lilac

name: Purple
description: mid to deep purple that reads clearly as purple - violet, grape

name: Baby Pink
description: pale, soft pink - blush, baby pink

name: Bright Pink
description: vivid pink - hot pink, bubblegum

name: Fuchsia
description: purple-leaning bright pink - magenta, fuchsia

name: Bright Red
description: vivid true red - pillar-box red, cherry, raspberry red

name: Dark Red
description: deep red that is still clearly red - brick, crimson

name: Burgundy
description: dark red with a purple or brown tint - wine, plum, aubergine, maroon, oxblood
